identification: Cardboard tray of garage/automobilia bits. Every piece, from the two photos: (1) RAC car badge: cast, nickel/chrome finish, crowned oval with rope/laurel border and large interlaced 'RAC' monogram, no enamel, mounting bolt on the back; early style (likely pre-war to 1950s), possibly an Australian RAC club badge rather than the UK enamel Union Jack type; the best piece. (2) Bedford round cast alloy badge with the Vauxhall griffin and 'BEDFORD' in a diagonal band, worn plating; looks like a Bedford truck hubcap or horn-push centre badge, 1950s-60s. (3) 'WAYFARER Road Liner' stamped aluminium plate with an Indian-head/arrow logo and star field, about 40 cm, from an Australian Wayfarer caravan (Wayfarer also made Landliner motorhomes in the 1970s). (4) Ford blue oval badge, enamel/plastic insert, 1970s-90s. (5) Ford blue oval mounted in a teal metallic plastic surround: a Ford bonnet/grille ornament from a 1970s-80s Falcon/Cortina era car (exact model unconfirmed). (6) Toyota chrome emblem, modern (1990s+). (7) Copper/brass-coloured pump oiler with long spout (no maker visible). (8) Blue hand pump oiler and (9) red hand pump oiler, matching the Australian REGA pump oiler pattern. (10) Green pressed-steel thumb-trigger oiler with long spout and grip ring. (11) Two pressed-steel push-bottom oil cans with spiral flexible spouts, rusty (one has a small paper label on the spout). (12) 'CARBOX' printed tin box (yellow border, landscape/pyramid scene), lid missing, with a black tin inside; Carbox was a 1920s petrol bowser brand (NZ/AU), so this may be a related garage tin; label too blurred to confirm. (13) Two galvanised pipe fittings/couplings (scrap). No Shell, Castrol or brass-bodied oilers of real value seen.

viewing_check: Turn the RAC badge over: look for maker's name (e.g. Elkington, Sheridan, Stokes, Amor), member number, patent or 'Reg' marks, and whether it is plated brass (good) or a lightweight recast (bad). Check the Bedford badge back for part number. Read the Carbox tin label and check the oilers' bases for maker names (Rega, Wesco, Braime, Eagle).
